hypothesis: The registry cleanup job svc-schema-cleanup permanently deleted version 3 of pg.public.orders-value (schema id 7) at 08:37, but Debezium still stamps id 7 on every record. After connect-2 restarted, wh-orders-sink's cold AvroConverter cache got 40403 for id 7 and the task failed. Do not register a new schema or restart the sink until id 7 is restored.

verdict.reason: The hypothesis identifies the permanent deletion of id 7 / version 3 by the registry cleanup job while the producer keeps stamping id 7, and it treats the sink task failure as the symptom. That covers the first failing layer (kafka-connect) and the root-cause layer (schema-registry), and it tells none of the wrong stories.
